# Incident Report: Overnight Refrigeration Failure at Rosewood Bakery

**Report ID:** RB-2024-017
**Date of Incident:** March 14, 2024
**Date of Report:** March 22, 2024
**Prepared by:** Facilities & Operations Review Team
**Distribution:** Owner, Store Manager, Head Baker, Facilities Contractor, Insurance Carrier

---

## Summary

At approximately 11:47 PM on March 13, 2024, the walk-in cooler at Rosewood Bakery experienced a compressor failure during a routine overnight defrost cycle. The failure was not detected until 4:10 AM on March 14, when the opening baker arrived. Internal cooler temperatures exceeded safe thresholds for approximately 4.5 hours, resulting in the loss of all temperature-sensitive inventory: cream-based pastries, custards, mousse cakes, filled layer cakes, and approximately 40 gallons of dairy products. No products were sold to customers. Total estimated loss: $6,800 in inventory and $3,200 in lost same-day sales. No health incident occurred.
